name: Obico
short_desc: Self-hosted AI 3D printer remote management and failure detection
author: Obico (prebuilt images by gabe565/docker-obico)
description: Obico is an open-source platform for remotely monitoring and managing 3D printers, with machine-learning failure detection, timelapses, and a companion mobile app. This app wraps the official obico-server using prebuilt images from gabe565/docker-obico (which tracks the upstream release branch). Services: Django web UI + websocket server (port 3334), Celery task worker, ML API, and Redis (SQLite for the database). After install: add the Django site via django-admin or 'manage.py site --add <SITE_DOMAIN>', then link printers with Obico for Klipper (moonraker-obico) or Obico for OctoPrint. Form fields: SITE_DOMAIN (public hostname, used for CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS and SITE_USES_HTTPS), DJANGO_SECRET_KEY (auto-generated), optional SMTP settings for email notifications.

form_fields.label: Site Domain
form_fields.hint: Public hostname of this Obico server (set as CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS; SITE_USES_HTTPS=True). Must match the dashboard domain, e.g. obico.407.lol

form_fields.label: Django Secret Key
form_fields.hint: Django secret key for cryptographic signing (auto-generated)

form_fields.label: SMTP Host
form_fields.hint: Optional. Mail server hostname for notification emails (leave blank to disable outbound email)

form_fields.label: SMTP Port
form_fields.hint: Optional. Mail server port (587 with TLS is typical)

form_fields.label: From Email
form_fields.hint: Optional. Sender address for notification emails
